title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Augustana College
description: Verifiable late-night dining and study spots for Augustana College students in Rock Island, Illinois.

cards.title: The Midnight C-Store
cards.subtitle: Westerlin Residence Hall
cards.notes: Grab snacks, drinks, and quick meals at this on-campus market. It stays open until midnight most nights, serving as the primary late-night hub for residential students.
cards.short_summary: On-campus convenience store open until midnight for late-night snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerlin Market is open until midnight Monday-Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sun-Thu; closes at 8 p.m. Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Continuous Campus Dining
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center for Student Life
cards.notes: Visit the main dining hall for all-you-care-to-eat meals. It serves as a central gathering point for students finishing late labs or evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering continuous service until 8 or 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gerber Center Dining Room is open until 8 p.m. or 9 p.m. depending on the day.
cards.source_title: The Gerber Center for Student Life - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until 8 p.m. Sun-Thu and 7 p.m. Fri-Sat; some sources indicate 9 p.m. during full sessions.

cards.title: The 4 AM Taco Run
cards.subtitle: 1533 38th Street
cards.notes: Drive over for late-night cravings. This location recently extended its hours, making it one of the few spots near campus open well past midnight on weekends.
cards.short_summary: Fast food staple near campus with extended late-night drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell in Rock Island is open until 4 a.m. on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Rock Island, IL - 1533-38th Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4 a.m. Thu-Sat; 2 a.m. other nights.

cards.title: Late Night Golden Arches
cards.subtitle: 2950 11th Street
cards.notes: Head to the 11th Street location for a late-night McFlurry or fries. The drive-thru remains active late into the night for off-campus students and late-night studiers.
cards.short_summary: Reliable late-night fast food with drive-thru service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's on 11th Street in Rock Island has drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. daily.

cards.title: The Local Scoop
cards.subtitle: 2520 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this Quad Cities institution for a late-night shake or cone. It's a popular spot for students to unwind after evening events or exams.
cards.short_summary: Famous local ice cream shop with drive-thru service open until 10 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Whitey's Ice Cream in Rock Island is open until 10 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Fri-Sat; 9 p.m. Sun-Thu.

cards.title: 24/7 Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: 1636 38th Street
cards.notes: Walk or drive to this 24-hour spot for emergency study snacks, coffee, or hot food. It is one of the few truly 24/7 options immediately adjacent to campus.
cards.short_summary: Always-open convenience store for late-night essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1636 38th St in Rock Island is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Midnight Study Sessions
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center for Student Life
cards.notes: Utilize the library's late hours for group projects or quiet study. It remains open until midnight most weeknights, providing a safe and productive environment.
cards.short_summary: Campus library offering late-night study spaces and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Tredway Library is open until midnight Monday-Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: The Gerber Center for Student Life - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sun-Thu; closes at 7 p.m. Fri and 6 p.m. Sat.

cards.title: Finals Week Fuel
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center Dining Hall
cards.notes: Join faculty and staff for a free late-night breakfast during finals week. It's a long-standing tradition to help students de-stress and refuel before exams.
cards.short_summary: A beloved finals week tradition featuring free late-night breakfast served by faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana's Midnight Breakfast is served from 10 p.m. until midnight during finals week.
cards.source_title: Midnight Breakfast, served with good humor | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Occurs during finals week; typically 10 p.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Late Night Pizza Delivery
cards.subtitle: 1600 38th Street
cards.notes: Order a late-night pizza for delivery or carryout. Located just south of campus, it's a frequent choice for dorm parties and late-night study groups.
cards.short_summary: Nearby pizza chain offering delivery and carryout until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pizza Hut on 38th St in Rock Island is open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Delivery in Rock Island, IL - Pizza Hut

cards.title: The Late Night Sub
cards.subtitle: 2532 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a sandwich or a baked potato at this local favorite. While not open past midnight, it serves as a popular early late-night dinner spot for students.
cards.short_summary: Local sandwich shop chain popular for quick evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hungry Hobo in Rock Island is open until 9 p.m. daily.
